claims.text: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged on identity of trip: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02840, and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-05T14:56:36+08:00 is the same instant as trip_record.started_at, so all three artifacts describe this one trip.

The second limb of the rider's burden is met on the figures: the trace measures 29.0 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 20.0 km, an excess of 9.0 km and 45.00%. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass — greater than 0.8 km absolute and greater than 20% of optimal — and the governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km convenience copy, which POL-RD-01 forbids citing for the threshold test.

The excess is additionally a MATERIAL deviation under POL-RD-01: 9.0 km exceeds the 8.0 km absolute materiality threshold. The 50% limb is not reached at 45.00%, but the materiality test is disjunctive and only one limb need fire, so the driver_profile consultation required by POL-RD-06 is engaged.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. It carries 228 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval with 100.0% coverage, the gaps array is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.0, and no consecutive-fix jump approaches 500 m. None of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation may be established on the trace alone, no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is required, and the escalation route in POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

The remedy is arithmetic, not discretionary. Charged_total is 51.38. The recomputed fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 20.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.4) + 0.80 platform fee = 37.312, the surge multiplier of 1.4 being read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and from nowhere else, and no ERP, toll, surcharge or waiting-time line is added because none exists. Refund = 51.38 - 37.312 = 14.068.

The refund figure survives both thresholds in POL-RD-02: 14.068 is far above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so NO_ACTION for de minimis is unavailable, and it is 27.38% of charged_total, well short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.10, being 14.068 rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05.

The driver's only answer is the counterparty statement 'Heavy traffic', which names no artifact. No advisory covers this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment expressly. Under POL-RD-13 the traffic assertion is tested against the advisory for this trip and nothing else, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run; the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08, it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal, and the ruling must record that it was discarded and that no advisory was on file.

Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, the absent advisory is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, and an artifact no party has cited leaves a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction in it. POL-RD-10(5) is therefore not a route to escalation on this record.

No exculpatory clause is open to the driver on the artifacts. POL-RD-05 cannot run: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no amended optimal and none may be derived. POL-RD-04 cannot run: the chat log holds 0 messages and trip_record.chat_message_count is 0, so there is no rider instruction to corroborate, and POL-RD-14 never arises. POL-RD-12 does not apply because vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. The driver's burden under POL-RD-08 is therefore undischarged on every available clause.

NO_ACTION is party-relative and is not a neutral resting point here: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION ruling would leave the rider carrying the whole charge, including the nine unjustified extra kilometres. A ruling that relieves the rider of that charge is the rider-preferring outcome.

Nothing is added on top of, and nothing is netted against, the POL-RD-02 figure: the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, off-route ERP total is 0.00, there is no airport surcharge, and the driver cannot claim the POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance compensation because distance_charged_km of 29.0 equals the trace distance. Under POL-RD-09(1) pass-through charges are already comprehended in the recomputed fare, so the refund stands at 14.10 and no separate correction issues.

claims.text: Even taking the rider's case at its highest — a 9.0 km excess measured on the governing trace figure of 29.0 km against a 20.0 km optimal route (EV-GPS-02840, EV-TRIP-02840) — the policy fixes the remedy arithmetically rather than by the sum the rider names. charged_total is 51.38; the recomputed fare under POL-RD-02 is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 20.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.4 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = 37.312; the refund is therefore 51.38 - 37.312 = 14.068, rounded up to SGD 14.10. The SGD 25.00 the rider contests is not supported by the policy's own arithmetic, and 14.10 is the ceiling on any amount this tribunal can move on this trip.

The rider pleads a fare charged 'at surge' as if the surge were the wrong, but POL-RD-02 applies the surge multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown — 1.4, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and nowhere else — to the recomputed optimal-route distance and time as well. The uplift is therefore not stripped out of the comparison, and a ruling that read the surge as absent on the recompute would refund the rider money that was correctly charged and exceed the policy figure.

The material deviation engages the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check, and that check clears the driver. On EV-DPROF-02840, deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 278, so neither limb of the pattern test is met: 0 is not 3 or more, and 0/278 = 0.000 is not 0.05 or more with a 30-day base above 40. No pattern being established, POL-RD-06(b)'s FULL_REFUND uplift and POL-RD-06(c)'s driver-conduct referral are both unavailable, and the rider's remedy is confined to the POL-RD-02 partial. Only those two fields are citable for this test (POL-GEN-01): the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only, cannot be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure, and cannot carry any adverse finding.

There is no pass-through or billing-integrity line for the rider to add to the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown on EV-FARE-02840 carries an empty erp_gantries list, zero tolls, an off-optimal-route ERP total of 0.00, and a zero airport surcharge on a trip running Yishun to Bishan that neither originates nor ends at an airport; POL-RD-09(4) therefore discloses no phantom line or wrongly applied surcharge, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids any off-route ERP being added on top of the POL-RD-02 refund, because such charges are already comprehended in it. Nothing is added to, and nothing is taken from, the 14.10 figure.

The driver's account of this trip, on the dispute record, is an external traffic cause — heavy traffic — and the driver here cites the identifier of the only artifact that could test it: EV-ADVIS-02840-01, the traffic advisory for this trip window. That artifact is MISSING from the bundle, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired; the impairment is disclosed here under POL-GEN-02(1), and the absence of an advisory is itself citable. With no advisory in the pool, POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all on this record: there is no advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window to compare against the trace's arrival at the segment, and no matched leave-and-rejoin to measure. A traffic cause asserted with no traffic_advisory is one of the situations POL-RD-10(5) names as a mandatory escalation, and the external-cause question this trip turns on is left undecided on the evidence as it stands. The contested amount should be held for a human reviewer, with the bundle as it is, rather than refunded on a record that cannot answer the question the driver raises.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties, on trip TRP-02840 (Yishun to Bishan, 2026-09-05): the rider is refunded SGD 14.10 and the driver's traffic excuse does not change that.

The excess also exceeds the 8.0 km materiality threshold, so this is a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is engaged.

Trace integrity (POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02840 carries 228 fixes at a 10 s interval with 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0. None of limbs (a)-(c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone, no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

Driver-profile check (POL-RD-06). On EV-DPROF-02840, deviation_flags_90d = 0 and completed_trips_90d = 278. Neither limb of the pattern test is met (0 is not 3 or more; 0/278 = 0.000 is not 0.05 or more). No pattern is established, so the POL-RD-06(b) FULL_REFUND uplift and the POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct referral are unavailable. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

The driver's traffic assertion. The driver's account ('Heavy traffic') names no advisory and cites no evidence ID. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested only against the traffic advisory for this trip, and EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). No comparison can be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the asserting party named no advisory identifier, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered and the request that this case be escalated is rejected on that ground.

No other exculpatory route is open: POL-RD-04 (no chat messages; EV-CHAT-02840 has 0), POL-RD-05 (no amended endpoints; amended_optimal_distance_km is null), POL-RD-12 (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL), POL-RD-11 (fare_model is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE).

The remedy (POL-RD-02). fare_model is METERED. charged_total = 51.38 (EV-FARE-02840). The surge multiplier 1.4 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and nowhere else. Recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 20.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.4) + 0.80 platform fee = (26.08 x 1.4) + 0.80 = 36.512 + 0.80 = 37.312. Refund = 51.38 - 37.312 = 14.068, rounded UP to SGD 14.10. No driver compensation under POL-RD-04: distance_charged_km (29.0) equals the trace distance, so there are no unbilled kilometres.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This is a rider-filed route-deviation claim on trip TRP-02840 (Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd to Blk 503 Bishan St 11, 5 Sep 2026, RYDE_X), billed SGD 51.38.

DEVIATION. All three artifacts carry the same trip id (TRP-02840) and the same pickup instant, so the rider's identity limb is met and the excess is shown. The governing trace figure (EV-GPS-02840, cited as POL-RD-01 requires in place of the rounded trip-record copy) is 29.0 km against the booked optimal of 20.0 km (EV-TRIP-02840): an excess of 9.0 km, or 45.0%. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass (more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal), and at 9.0 km the deviation is additionally MATERIAL (greater than 8.0 km). The trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 228 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m, so the excess stands on the trace and no independent corroboration is needed. No exculpatory clause is open to the driver: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02840) holds zero messages, so there is no rider-requested detour to weigh under POL-RD-04; pickup and dropoff were never amended, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver's answer is 'heavy traffic'. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run at all, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver's own assertion names no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) applies: the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not the cited-and-missing artifact that POL-RD-10(5) escalates on, and the deviation stands at the measured figure with the refund computed against the booked optimal route. I have considered and REJECTED the driver's argument that POL-RD-10(5) compels escalation to a human reviewer: the driver cites no advisory as exculpatory evidence (the driver's side concedes POL-RD-03 cannot run), and merely naming the identifier of an absent artifact while arguing about its absence does not turn a gap into the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes. No POL-RD-10 trigger fired, and the trace itself is unimpaired, so POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged either.

REMEDY (arithmetic, not discretionary). Charged total: SGD 51.38. Recomputed optimal-route fare: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 20.0 km + 0.28 x 26.0 min) x 1.4 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 37.312, the surge multiplier 1.4 being read from EV-FARE-02840.surge_multiplier and nowhere else. Refund: 51.38 - 37.312 = SGD 14.068, rounded UP to SGD 14.10. That is well above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and 27.4% of the charge, far short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.10. The SGD 25.00 the rider pleaded is not supported by the policy's own arithmetic; SGD 14.10 is the ceiling on what this ruling can move. NO_ACTION would have been party-relative here and would have left the rider carrying the whole charge.

The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was run because the deviation is material, and it clears the driver: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 278, so no pattern is established, the FULL_REFUND uplift is unavailable, and there is no driver-conduct referral.

Nothing is added to or netted against that figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, zero tolls, a zero off-route ERP total and no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09(4) discloses no billing-integrity defect and no separate pass-through correction issues; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding off-route ERP on top of a POL-RD-02 refund in any event. No driver compensation is due under POL-RD-04: the distance billed (29.0 km) equals the trace distance, so there are no unbilled kilometres.

The monetary effect (SGD 14.10) is above the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed and is held for release. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
